channel.name: Karma Keeps Score
channel.description:
Welcome to Karma Keeps Score, where nobody gets away with it forever.
The man who mocked a cleaner. The sister who stole the inheritance. The boss who fired a loyal worker to save a few dollars. They thought nobody was watching. Karma was.
Every story here builds to one moment: the instant life hands the bill back to the person who earned it.
Subscribe for powerful karma stories every week.
